scope: EXT-F-1003-T46; Settings trusted Save to real released-worker rediscovery evidence

adjudications.finding: Unrelated pre-Save or mixed handler invocations can satisfy the observer
adjudications.ruling: Refuted as an actual caller path in this isolated guest exercise; strengthened defensively with a Save boundary and exact ordered pair
adjudications.evidence: Repository census of DESKTOP_REDISCOVER finds sends only in SettingsView.tsx Save/Clear and debug/BridgesView.tsx user actions. bootstrap.ts startup and alarm handlers call probeDesktop directly, never the rediscovery message handler. The owned fresh browser opens one settled guest panel, exercises no Bridges view, and performs exactly one Save while observation is active. No clear/reload occurs until observation closes.
adjudications.change: Arm immediately before the trusted Save click, reject any earlier pause, retain every pause, and require exactly handler entry then post-probe completion after the boundary. Do not choose the first matching entries out of an ambiguous event set.
adjudications.cost_if_wrong: A new automatic rediscovery sender invalidates the isolated single-caller assumption; the exact-pair check rejects extra observed invocations and the caller census must be revisited. This is not a general multi-client request-correlator.

adjudications.finding: Resume rejection can settle after acceptance
adjudications.ruling: Confirmed by asynchronous control flow; repaired
adjudications.change: Every pause retains a settled resume result. A read snapshots the pause list and awaits all matching resume promises before returning evidence. Debugger close also awaits outstanding resumes and rejects errors before acceptance is recorded.

adjudications.finding: Debugger teardown error skips override cleanup
adjudications.ruling: Confirmed by sequential fail-fast finally; repaired
adjudications.change: Attempt watcher teardown, worker detach, and trusted UI override clearing independently; record any cleanup errors as a failing criterion. Existing outer harness still destroys only its owned disposable browser/profile.

adjudications.finding: A health request must be required to prove rediscovery
adjudications.ruling: Not applicable to T46; native messaging is a valid transport and may skip HTTP
adjudications.evidence: inventory.json T46 expects rediscovery to run, not successful desktop connectivity. bootstrap.ts handler awaits probeDesktop before its availability broadcast; bridge.ts prefers native health. The optional HTTP listener remains diagnostic and returns 503, never fabricated health.

preserved: Real trusted pointer and keyboard actions
